content.short: Stake SOL, ETH, NEAR and more through Meta Pool and keep a liquid token you can use across DeFi.
content.description: Meta Pool began on NEAR and now offers liquid staking on several networks. Whether you stake SOL, ETH or the native tokens of NEAR, ICP, Aurora or Story, you receive a receipt token that collects validator rewards and can still be used in DeFi. Each deployment has been audited separately. Governance runs through mpDAO, which also funds new projects through a milestone-based incubator. Meta Pool has run since 2021, has paid out millions of dollars in staking rewards, and offers Node Studio, a one-click way to deploy and run a validator without managing servers.
content.meta: Liquid staking for SOL, ETH, NEAR and more, with receipt tokens usable across DeFi. Explore Meta Pool on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Meta Pool, a Liquid Staking Protocol, Suffers $27M Exploit
resources.tldr: A bug let an attacker mint unlimited mpETH, but thin liquidity meant only a small amount could be cashed out.
